summary: Chunk 3 (units 83-123): no wrong split of the Sanskrit tokens, no invented content; main errors are (a) 88 'ādika' split where the print has ādi+kāśmarya, (b) 104 bare Hindi स्नेह, (c) 112 karbudāra tagged probable instead of disputed. Minor: 89 pakvā unflagged (paktvā likely), 109 w keeps printed śāmalī against rule 6, 85 non-form entry in text_flags, Hindi lacking the 'unclear' marks that English has (85, 93, 94, 102, 109, 121), added '(these)' in 95 and '(stool)' in 120, 'siddha' alternatives in gloss, GROUPING wording ('completes' etc.) across many units, missing botanical names. Identifications judged acceptable as hedged: balā, sthirā (disputed), karīra (disputed), suvarcalā (disputed), jiṅgiṇī, sarjarasa, kulmāṣa, ghana=musta. hatvā 'having destroyed' (97, 116) and sa-vidagdham (107) left for the owner. Units needing a human decision: 85, 93, 94, 98, 99, 107, 109, 120, 121, 123. 123 may link to 122 (six-item count in 124).
glossary_suggestions: ळ (ḻ) in this Marathi-printed edition is the letter l (bastimaḻān, 97): normalise silently, record once.
vha for hva (yaṣṭyāvha 101/102, śatāvhā ch01): print habit of reversed conjunct; flag once per unit, correct form in w.
ādi as last member of a compound is 'ādi' (balā-sthirā-ādi), 'ādika' only where the print has -ādika-/-ādikān.
Hindi sneha = स्नेह यानी तेल या वसा (bare स्नेह = affection).
karbudāra: tag disputed everywhere (commonly white-flowered kovidāra).
